first_click_find_rate.definition: Share of runs whose first topic matches the expected topic

top_two_margin.definition: Share choosing the top placement minus share choosing the second, per element
top_two_margin.scope: per element, or a recorded ruling

inter_labeler_kappa.scope: per round, after at most one sharpening round

audit_agreement.definition: Agreement of a 10 percent audit sample with the ruled label

abandonment_by_neighbor_pair.definition: Human cannot_tell verdicts grouped by the pair of topics involved

runs_per_question.definition: Probe repeats per question at G4

decision_time_seconds.definition: Seconds from question shown to verdict (humans)
